Amharic: በሌሴቶ ገጠራማ አካባቢ ብዙ ቤቶች ወይ የኤሌክትሪክ እጥረት አለባቸው ወይ በሚገኝበት ቦታ እንኳን የሚጠቀሙት ኤሌክትሪክ በጣም አነስተኛ ነው፡፡

Source: Through the years, various government initiatives, and efforts to promote use by electricity companies, have also largely been unsuccessful.
Luganda: Emyaka egiyiseewo, entekateeka za gavumenti ne kaweefube w’ebitongole by’amasannyalaze okutumbula enkozesa yaago, nabyo bigudde butaka.
Yoruba: Yípo àwọn ọdún, onírúnrú àkànṣe-iṣẹ́ láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìjọba, láti ṣe ìgbélárugẹ́ ìlò àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ mọ̀nàmọ́ná kò jásí àseyọrí kankan.
Zulu: Phakathi neminyaka, izinhlelo ezahlukene zikahulumeni, kanye nemizamo yokukhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezinkaphani zikagesi, nayo kwaba nhlanga zemuka nomoya.
Hausa: A cikin shekarun da suka gabata, tsare-tsare daban-daban na gwamnati, da yunƙurin inganta amfani da kamfanonin wutar lantarki, su ma ba su yi nasara ba.
Northern Sotho: Mo mengwageng ye e fetilego, masolo a mehutahuta a mmušo, le matsapa a go tšwetša pele go šomiša ga mohlagse ka dikhamphani tša mohlagase, ga se a atlega.
Amharic: ባለፉት አመታት የኤሌክትሪክ ኩባንያዎችን ጥቅም ለማስተዋወቅ በመንግስት የተደረጉ ተነሳሽነቶች እና ጥረቶች ደግሞ በአብዛኛው አልተሳኩም፡፡

Source: Researchers therefore wanted to understand the challenges that prevent people in rural Lesotho from using electricity.
Luganda: Noolwekyo abanoonyereza baayagala okutegeera ebizibu ebiremesa abantu b’omu byalo, mu ggwanga lya Lesotho okukozesa amasannyalaze.
Yoruba: Ni àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe fẹ́ mọ àwọn ìpèníjà tí ó ènà ìlò iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná fún àwọn ènìyàn tí wọ́n wà ní ìgbèríko Lesotho.
Zulu: Ngakho-ke abacwaningi bebefuna ukuqonda izinselelo ezivimba abantu basemaphandleni ase-Lesotho ekusebenziseni ugesi.
Hausa: Don haka, masu binciken sun so su fahimci ƙalubalen da suke hana mutanen karkara amfani da wutar lantarki a Lesotho.
Northern Sotho: Ka fao banyakišiši ba be ba nyaka go kwešiša mathata ao a bego a thibela batho ba ka dinagamageng tša Lesotho go šomiša mohlagase.
Amharic: ስለዚህ ተመራማሪዎች በሌሴቶ ገጠራማ አካባቢ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ኤሌክትሪክን እንዳይጠቀሙ የሚከለክሉትን ተግዳሮቶች ለመረዳት ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: They looked at electricity usage data from the Lesotho Electricity Company (LEC), the government’s Rural Electrification Unit (REU), and Lesotho’s Bureau of Statistics (BoS).
Luganda: Baatunuulira obubaka obukwata ku nkozesa y’amasannyalaze okuva mu Kitongole ky’Amasannyalaze mu ggwanga lya Lesotho (LEC), Ekitongole kya gavumenti ekivugaanyizibwa mu Masannyalaze mu Byalo (REU), n’Ekitongole ky’Emiwendo mu ggwanga lya Lesotho (BoS).
Yoruba: Wọ́n wo dátà ìlò iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná láti Ilé-iṣẹ́ Mọ̀nàmọ́ná ti Lesotho (LEC), Ẹka Ìfìlòinálọ́lẹ̀ ti Ìjọba (REU), àti Ilé-iṣẹ́ Ìṣèṣirò ti Lesotho (BoS).
Zulu: Babheke ukusetshenziswa kukagesi kulwazi oluqoqiwe oluvela kwi-Lesotho Electrification Company (LEC), i-Rural Electrification Unit (REU) kahulumeni, kanye ne-Bureau of Statistics (BoS) yase-Lesotho.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun duba bayanan amfani da wutar lantarki daga Kamfanin Lantarki na Lesotho (LEC), Sashin Bayar da Lantarki na Karkara (REU), da Ofishin Ƙididdiga na Lesotho (BoS).
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šomiša tshedimošo ya mabapi le go šomiša mohlagse go tšwa go Khamphani ya Mohlagase ya Lesotho (LEC), Lekala la go Tsenya Mohlagase Dinagamagaeng (REU) le go Biro ya Dipalopalo (BoS).
Amharic: ከሌሴቶ ኤሌክትሪክ ኩባንያ (ሌ.ኤ.ኩ)፣ ከመንግስታዊው የገጠር ኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት ክፍል (ገ.ኤ.ክ) እና ከሌሴቶ ስታትስቲክስ ቢሮ (ሌ.ስ.ቢ)የኤሌክትሪክ አጠቃቀም መረጃን ተመልክተዋል፡፡

Source: They wanted to find out how electricity use changed through the years and what energy sources people were using instead.
Luganda: Baayagala okuzuula engeri enkozesa y’amasannyalaze gye yajja ng’ekyuka mu myaka egyali giyise awamu n’amaanyi abantu ge baali bakozesa mu kifo ky’amasannyalaze.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ wádìí bí ìlò iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná ṣe yí láàrin àwọn ọdún wọ̀nyí àti pé èwo ni orísun agbára tí àwọn ènìyàn ń lò dípò.
Zulu: Bebefuna ukuthola ukuthi ugesi ububza kanjani eminyakeni nanokuthi imuphi umthombo wamandla obusetshenziswa abantu kunalokho.
Hausa: Suna so ne su gano yadda amfani da wutar lantarki ya canza a cikin shekaru da da tushen makamashin da mutane suke amfani da su maimakon haka.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go tseba ka fao go šomiša mohlagase go fetogilego ka gona mo mengwageng ye mentši le gore sebakeng sa go šomiša mohlagase batho ba be ba šomiša ditlabelo dife tša enetši.
Amharic: ባለፉት ዓመታት የኤሌክትሪክ አጠቃቀም እንዴት እንደተቀየረ እና በምትኩ ሰዎች ምን አይነት የሃይል ምንጮችን እንደሚጠቀሙ ማወቅ ፈልገው ነበር፡፡

Source: Researchers said the LEC data showed that average household electricity consumption decreased by 60% between 2001 and 2016.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti obubaka bwa LEC nti omukkati gw’enkozesa y’amasannyalaze mu maka gwakendeera n’ebitundu 60% mu bbanga eriri wakati wa 2001 ne 2016.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé dátà LEC fi hàn pé àpapọ̀ iná mọ̀nà-mọ́ná tí ìdílé fi 60% dín kù láàrin 2001 sí 2016.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathena ulwazi oluqoqiwe le-LEC luveze ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kukagesi ezindlini ngokwesilinganiso kwehle ngama-60% phakathi kwezi-2001 nangowezi-2016.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce bayanan LEC sun nuna cewa matsakaicin amfani da wutar lantarki na gida ya ragu da kashi 60% tsakanin shekaar 2001 da 2016.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore tshedimošo ya LEC e laeditše gore tšhomišo ya mohklagse ye e tlwaelegilego ya ka malapeng e fokotšegile ka 60% magareng ga 2001 le 2016.
Amharic: የሌ.ኤ.ኩ መረጃ እንደሚያሳየው በ2001 እና 2016 መካከል አማካይ የቤት ውስጥ የኤሌክትሪክ ፍጆታ በ60% እንደቀነሰ ተመራማሪዎች ተናግረዋል፡፡

Source: Surprisingly, this decrease happened even though the Lesotho Electricity Company had gained nearly 10 times more customers during that time.
Luganda: Ekyewuunyisa, okukendeera kuno kwaliwo newankubadde nga mu kiseera ekyo Ekitongole ky’Amasannyalaze mu ggwanga lya Lesotho kyali kifunye bakasitoma abakubisaamu emirundi 10 okusinga abo be kyalina.
Yoruba: Ó yani lẹ́nu, ẹ̀dínkù yìí ṣẹlẹ̀ bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé Ilé-iṣẹ́ Mọ̀nàmọ́ná ti Lesotho tí ní ìlọ́po àwọn oníbàárà10 láàrin àsìkò náà.
Zulu: Ngokumangalisayo, lokhukwehla kwenzeke ngisho noma i-Lesotho Electricity Company ibisizuze ngokuphindandindwe kali-10 abathengi ngaso lesosikhathi.
Hausa: Abin mamaki, wannan raguwar ta faru duk da cewa Kamfanin Lantarki na Lesotho ya sami ƙarin abokan ciniki kusan sau 10 a wannan lokacin.
Northern Sotho: Sa go makatša ke gore, go fokotšega mo go diregile le ge e le gore Khamphani ya Mohlagase ya Lesotho e hweditše badiriši ba bangwe makga a go nyaka go fihla go a 10 ka yona nako yeo.
Amharic: በሚገርም ሁኔታ በዚያን ጊዜ የሌሴቶ የኤሌክትሪክ ኩባንያ ወደ 10 እጥፍ የሚጠጉ ደንበኞችን ቢያገኝም ይህ መቀነስ ግን መከሰቱ አልቀረም፡፡

Source: Their analysis showed people often still prefer to use traditional fuels, like wood, because they are cheaper.
Luganda: Okwekaliriza kwabwe kwalaga nti abantu kikyabasingira okukozesa amasannyalaze ag’ennono gamba ng’enku, kubanga ga layisi.
Yoruba: Àtúpalẹ̀ wọn fi hàn pé ó ṣì tún tẹ́ àwọn ènìyàn lọ́rùn àwọn ohun ìdáná ìbílẹ̀, bí i igi ìdáná, torí pé owó wọn rọjú.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziya kwabo kukhombise ukuthi ezikhathini eziningi abantu basakuncamela ukusebenzisa inkambu yendabuko, njengezinkuni, ngoba zishibhile.
Hausa: Binciken da suka yi ya nuna cewa mutane sukan fi son amfani da mai na gargajiya, kamar itace, saboda suna da araha.
Northern Sotho: Ditshekatsheko tša bona di laeditše gore batho gantši ba sa rata go šomišwa dibešwa tša setlwaedi, tša go swana le dikgong, ka gobane ga di ture.

Source: Other challenges were the difficulty of building power grid infrastructure in the Lesotho mountains, and the need for better government policies around affordable electricity.
Luganda: Okusoomooza okulala bwe buzibu bw’okuzimba entindiro z’amasannyalaze mu nsozi z’omu Lesotho, awamu n’obwetaavu bw’enkola za gavumenti ennungi ku masannyalaze agasoboka.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìpèníjà mìíràn ni ti kíkọ́ ìbùdó ìpèsè agbára amáyédẹrùn sí orí àwọn àpáta Lesotho, àti ìlò fún àwọn ètò-ìmúlò tí ó dára láti ọ̀dọ̀ ìjọba nípa oẃ iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná tí ò gani lára jù.
Zulu: Ezinye izinselelo bekuwubunzima bokwakha ingqalasizinda zikagesi ezintabeni zase-Lesotho, isidingo sezinqubomgomo ezingcono zikahulumeni mayelana nogesi othengekayo.

Northern Sotho: Ditlhohlo tše dingwe e bile go swara bothata go aga mananeokgoparara a kabo ya mohlagase ka dithabeng tša ka Lesotho, le gore go hlokega melawana ye mekaone ya mmušo mabapi le mohlagase wa gos e ture.
Amharic: በሌሴቶ ተራሮች ላይ የሃይል መስመር መሰረተ ልማት ግንባታ አስቸጋሪነት እና በተመጣጣኝ የኤሌክትሪክ ዋጋ ዙሪያ የተሻሉ የመንግስት ፖሊሲዎች አስፈላጊነት ሌሎቹ ተግዳሮቶች ነበሩ፡፡

Source: To address some of these issues, the researchers suggested using renewable energy sources, like solar power.
Luganda: Okusobola okukola ku nsonga zino ezimu, abanoonyereza baateesa nti amasannyalaze agatakaliza gamba ng’amaanyi g’enjuba gasaanye gakozesebwe.
Yoruba: Láti kojú díẹ̀ lára àwọn ìsòro wọ̀nyí, àwọn aṣèwádìí náà dábàá lílo orísun agbára alálòtúnlò bí i agbára òòrùn.
Zulu: Ukubhekana nezinye zalezi zinkinga, abacwaningi baphakamise ukusetshenziswa kwemithombo yamandla avuselelekayo, njengamandla elanga.

Northern Sotho: Go rarolla a mangwe a mathata a, banyakišiši ba šišintše gore go šomišwe methopo ya mohlagse wa go šomišwa leswa, go swana le mohlagase wa sola.
Amharic: ከእነዚህ ጉዳዮች መካከል አንዳንዶቹን ለመፍታት እንደ የፀሀይ ሀይል ያሉ ታዳሽ የሃይል ምንጮችን ለመጠቀም ሃሳብ አቅርበዋል፡፡

Source: They stated that by installing renewable technologies, instead of traditional electric power, electricity and maintenance costs would be lower.
Luganda: Baagamba nti wakati mu kuteekawo amasannyalaze agatakaliza mu kifo ky’amasannyalaze ag’ennono, ebisale by’amasannyalaze n’ensimbi ezeetaagibwa okugaddukanya bijja kuba wansi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé nípa ṣíṣe ìfilọ́lẹ̀ àwọn ìmọ̀-ẹ̀rọ alálòtúnlò, dípò agbára iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná ìbílẹ̀, iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná iye ìpamọ́ rẹ̀ yóò dín kù.
Zulu: Bashilo ukuthi ngokufaka ubuchwepheshe obuvuselelekayo, esikhundleni samandla kagesi wendabuko, ugesi nokunakekelwa kwawo kungabaphansi.

Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba bolela gore go tsenya ditheknolotši tša mohlagse wa go šomišwa leswa, sebakeng sa mohlagse wa setlwaedi, mohlagase le ditshenyegelo tša go o hlokomela di tla ba fase.

Source: This may encourage people to use electricity instead of traditional fuels, they said.

Yoruba: Èyí lè ṣe ìwúrí fún àwọn ènìyàn láti lo iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná kàkà kí wọ́n lo àwọn epo ìpìlè ni wọ́n wí.
Zulu: Lokhu kungagqugqumezela abantu ukuba basebenzise ugesi esikhundleni sokusebenzisa owendabuko, basho njalo.
Hausa: Hakan na iya ƙarfafa gwiwar mutane su yi amfani da wutar lantarki maimakon mai na gargajiya, a cewarsu.
Northern Sotho: Se se ka hlohleletša batho go šomiša mohalgse sebakeng sa go šomišwa dibešwa tša setlwaedi, ba boletše bjale.
Amharic: ይህም ከባህላዊ ነዳጆች ይልቅ ሰዎች ኤሌክትሪክን እንዲጠቀሙ ሊያበረታታ ይችላል ብለዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers said future studies should focus on how best to provide electricity connections in rural areas, and should identify other reasons why rural people still prefer traditional energy sources.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti okunoonyereza okunaakolebwa mu biseera ebijja kusaanye kutunuulire engeri esingako eyinza okukozesebwa okutambuza amasannyalaze mu byalo, era kuzuule ensonga endala lwaki bannakyalo bakyettanira okukozesa amasannyalaze ag’ennono.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé kí iṣẹ́ ìwádìí ọjọ́-iwájú kọjú mọ ọ̀nà tí ó dára jùlọ láti pèsè iná mọ̀nàmọ́ná ní àwọn agbègbè ìgbèríko, kí wọn ó sì tọ́ka sí àwọn ìdí mìíràn tí ó jẹ́ kí àwọn ènìyàn ṣì yan àwọn orísùn ìlò agbára ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ láàyò.
